evals.name: tdd-red-green-refactor-failing-test-before-implementation
evals.prompt: 자율 mode 에서 새 validateEmail 함수 구현해줘. TDD 로 해줘.
evals.expected_output: Red (failing test 먼저 작성, spec 에서 도출) → Green (최소 구현) → Refactor → Commit 순서 의무. 자율 mode 이므로 메인이 직접 red 단계 진입 금지 — fresh sonnet dispatch 필수.

assertions.text: Response mandates writing a failing test BEFORE any implementation code per §TDD sequence step 1 (Red)
Response applies the autonomous mode rule: main context cannot directly enter TDD red stage — must dispatch via fresh sonnet (kzk-large-task-delegation) per §자율 mode 메인 직접 TDD 금지
Response specifies what is forbidden to read at red stage: implementation body, sibling function bodies, existing test files per §Anti-pattern — Test-from-implementation
Response includes or references the self-check: 'is this test derived from spec/acceptance criteria, not from the current implementation shape?'
Response specifies halt + Q-TDD-MAIN user-queue entry if main attempts direct TDD red stage in autonomous mode
